title: Tabzoola Tab Price Index and Custom Index Tab Open Data: monthly tab prices, binder capacity, court tab rules and the most-ordered tab titles
description:
Open data published by Tabzoola (tabzoola.com), which sells custom index tab dividers made in Schaumburg, Illinois by its sister company Anselmo Die & Index (same owner), which has made index tabs since 1993.

  • custom-index-tab-prices.csv: the source data of the Tabzoola Tab Price Index, the monthly published price of custom printed paper tab sets, 3 to 25 tabs, 25 to 1,000 sets, setup included. The October 2026 edition puts a 5-tab paper set at $2.35 per set at 100 sets. Each edition lives at its own dated address (https://tabzoola.com/tab-price-index/2026-10) and is never revised.
  • binder-capacity.csv: sheets and tab dividers that fit in every 3-ring binder size, round and D-ring.
  • court-tab-rules.csv: court rules on exhibit and appendix tabs, each with the verbatim quote and official source.
  • binder-tab-sets-by-use.csv and medical-chart-sections.csv: ready-made section lists by binder type and care setting.
  • most-ordered-tab-titles.csv and most-ordered-tab-sets.csv: the titles organizations actually print on index tabs, from 30 years of production records, 1996 to 2026.
  • index-tab-questions.csv/.jsonl: 890 question-and-answer pairs about custom index tabs and binders.

Current prices: https://tabzoola.com/pricing. Tabzoola Tab Price Index, every edition: https://tabzoola.com/tab-price-index. Cite it as: Tabzoola Tab Price Index, edition.
